about: Eleven sources share amount and region: the first card keeps every own field its call picked, every later card at most two per pick, and a target at most eight in all; payments' joined invoice.invoiced_amount is not served beside its own total_paid_amount, and invoices serves invoiced_amount on its own card.

source_info.one_line_summary: One row per sale, every channel combined: store, web and partner sales together.
source_info.docs: One row per sale, every channel combined: store, web and partner sales together. The amount is the sale's value in US dollars before tax; the region is the sales region of the selling team.

entities.name: total_amount
entities.description: Total amount of the sales in scope, in US dollars before tax.

entities.name: avg_amount
entities.description: Average amount per sale, in US dollars before tax.

entities.name: region_code
entities.description: Sales region of the selling team, one of North, East or West.

entities.name: sales_region_name
entities.description: Long name of the sales region of the selling team.

source_info.one_line_summary: One row per payment received against an invoice.
source_info.docs: One row per payment received against an invoice. Reach the invoice's billing region through the invoice join.

entities.name: total_paid_amount
entities.description: Total amount received in payments, in US dollars.

entities.name: invoice.billing_region
entities.description: Billing region of the invoiced customer. Reached from payments through invoice, a left join: a payments row with no match keeps a null here, so grouping or counting by it follows payments's rows.

source_info.one_line_summary: One row per planned budget line of a region, for the finance plan.
source_info.docs: One row per planned budget line of a region, for the finance plan. Amounts are planned, not actual.

entities.name: budget_region
entities.description: Region the budget line is planned for.

source_info.one_line_summary: One row per commission paid to a sales rep.
source_info.docs: One row per commission paid to a sales rep.

entities.name: rep_region
entities.description: Region of the sales rep paid.

source_info.one_line_summary: One row per price quote given to a prospect; a quote is not a sale.
source_info.docs: One row per price quote given to a prospect; a quote is not a sale.

source_info.one_line_summary: One row per refund paid back to a customer.
source_info.docs: One row per refund paid back to a customer. The amount is the refunded amount.

entities.name: refund_region
entities.description: Region of the store that paid the refund.

source_info.one_line_summary: One row per invoice sent to a customer.
source_info.docs: One row per invoice sent to a customer. The amount is the invoiced amount; the region is the billing region of the customer.

entities.name: invoiced_amount
entities.description: Total invoiced amount, in US dollars.

entities.name: billing_region
entities.description: Billing region of the invoiced customer.
